Messages.Author: John P.
Messages.Body:
Hello there,

Path of Death and the Soul. "When a minion controlled by another
Methuselah is burned, you may tap this card to search your library
(shuffle afterward), ash heap or hand for a Master: Discipline card.
Move 1 blood from the blood bank and that card to a ready vampire
you control."

Q: When another methuselah is ousted... have in effect his minions been
burned allowing me to use the path?

Thanks,

-JTP
Winnipeg

Messages.Author: salem
Messages.Body:
On Sun, 30 Nov 2003 00:19:34 GMT, "John P." <verg...@hotmail.com>
scrawled:



9.1. Victory Points
When a Methuselah runs out of pool counters, she is ousted
from the game. If you are ousted, all the cards you control are
burned.

cool!
